title: Compare CATPart folders
description: Filenames are not used for matching. Geometry results are suggestions that require review.
runPrompt: Select both CATPart folders, then start the analysis.
noCatparts: No CATPart files were found in at least one folder.
geometryToggle: Also suggest geometric pairs with CADMPEG
geometryToggleHint: Optional; at most 100 unmatched files per folder. Choose a smaller subfolder for geometry suggestions on a subset.

geometryStatus.not_requested: Exact SHA-256 mode: CADMPEG was not used.
geometryStatus.not_needed: No remaining pair needs geometry analysis.
geometryStatus.available: CADMPEG produced partial signatures; candidates still require review.
geometryStatus.missing: CADMPEG is missing or misconfigured; exact comparison is still available.
geometryStatus.limit_exceeded: Exact comparison covered every file; CADMPEG suggestions require at most 100 unmatched files per folder.

exactSkipped: Identical copies hidden: {{oldCount}} older and {{newCount}} newer ({{groups}} group(s)).
candidateDescription: The score compares partial geometry primitives. It does not prove the files are the same part.
pairConflict: This file is already assigned to another confirmed pair.
noCandidates: No candidate pair reached the heuristic threshold.
unmatchedTitle: Remaining files without an identical counterpart
noneUnmatched: No remaining files without an identical counterpart.
unmatchedDescription: A remaining file may be modified, added, or removed; the absence of an identical hash does not distinguish these cases.
limit: SHA-256 comparison supports up to 20,000 CATPart files per folder.
